drop_hint: Drop PDF files or a folder here
opt_auto: Find the gutter on each page
lbl_position_hint: Pages where no gutter is found are split here. Drag the red line in the preview to move it for that page only.
lbl_overlap_hint: + keeps a strip of the gutter on both pages; − trims the gutter shadow away.
preview_empty: Add a file to see a preview
preview_skipped: This page is left out of the result
lbl_line_manual: Split at {pos} (set by hand · double-click to reset)
msg_failed_pages: {count} pages failed and were kept as in the original. See the log.
msg_large_file: {name} has {pages} pages. Estimated time about {minutes} min. Continue?
warn_text_pdf: Not a scanned PDF (it contains text). Split it anyway?
err_empty_result: Every page is set to be skipped, nothing to save: {name}
log_summary: {pages} pages → {out_pages} pages ({split} split, {detected} of them auto-fitted)
cli_desc: Splits a PDF scanned two pages per sheet (a book scanned open) into left and right pages, keeping the original image quality. Run without inputs to open the GUI.
cli_position: Split line, %% of the page width (default 50). Used where no gutter is found
cli_overlap: Center overlap %% (-4 to 4, default 0). + keeps the gutter on both pages, - trims it
cli_direction: Reading order: ltr (left page first) or rtl (right page first), default ltr
cli_pages: Pages to split: auto (landscape only), all, none; default auto
cli_auto: Find the gutter on each page (default)
cli_no_auto: No gutter detection; split every page at --position
cli_help: show this help message and exit
